comments.author: @TravelKismet
comments.text: A country with over 220,000 islands that hasn’t been in a war since 1814 honestly sounds like a fairytale—right up until you hear about tax rates reaching 60%  and paying $25 for a single plate of pasta . For anyone actually living in Sweden, does the peace and quality of life easily outweigh the cold winters and high costs, or is it getting tougher to keep up?
